purpose: Calibrates the scoring path and proves the happy path. A finding raised against CleanCloud is a false positive, and the tests treat it as one.
assertions: Trust Score is at least 80 and the band is approve.
No Adversarial Conduct flag is raised on the review or the vendor record.
Every critical Model Armor filter reports EXECUTION_SUCCESS, so a clean-stamp is issued for every document.
The ISO certificate expiry is in the future, so the deterministic expiry check produces no finding.
The SOC 2 report period ends inside the last 12 months, so the staleness check produces no finding.
The report scope covers the service being bought, so the scope check produces no finding.
A named auditor and an opinion are both present, so that check produces no finding.
The review reaches GATED with gate_scope=decision and cannot reach DECIDED without a signed approval token.
